b4BaselineNote: RULED SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17: the B4 zero-framework-diff gate (BG-COMPOSE-SIF, BRIEF-B4) measures the B4 branch's diff against THIS commit, not against edfiPluginAcceptedCommitRecorded. The two differ, and the difference is real and legitimate: the DERIVED order (D1-D4) moved lib/bridge-framework between b86f57a and 3e5357f — the SOURCE_ACQUISITION_REGISTRY, four real-client judge contract fixes, and the sssomExporter validator-conformance commit. b4TwinRangeNote: test-bridgeAcceptanceSif.js's BG-COMPOSE-SIF twin runs the IDENTICAL diff command over edfiPluginAcceptedCommitRecorded..b4BaselineCommit, where the DERIVED order really did move lib/bridge-framework, and asserts NON-EMPTY. A diff gate that reports EMPTY is indistinguishable from one whose path list is misspelled, whose command failed, or whose parser never sees a line — all of those report EMPTY too, greenly, forever. The twin turns the silence into a measurement. Pattern for every diff-from-tag gate (RULED SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17).
b4BaselineMoverNote: NAMED MOVER (RULING BS-7, SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17): the baseline moved from 3e5357f6fba41b2575e893a9465bf4d557b424e2 to 55357b5 when the supervisor rebased b4-sif-plugin onto the post-D-CLEAR HEAD.
